name: Group work
note: The Class XI classroom family for the coordinate structure: a small group, three or four jobs, one binding constraint that only the right conversation reveals (SCHOOL_AND_PROGRESSION.md, Coordinate a group). Projects, debate, events and practicals reach it. The method thresholds are chosen: Communication starts at 0 and creative_aptitude seeds it with 10, 25, 45 or 70 XP by rank, so rank 1 splits a task list, rank 2 runs a check-in and rank 3 settles from the ledger.
